summary: This room is the palace's own ceremony-and-meta-infrastructure neighborhood — nearly every operational card (Deposit, Harvest, Weave, Walk, Return, Revival, Spore Check, Baton, Closing Well, Self-Model Update, Schema) plus their Context companions and a scatter of standards and worklists. The strongest cross-cutting find is that Reflective Practice — a 2026-09 newcomer starving for inbound links — already names five of this room's own ceremonies (Weave, Return, Spore Check, Revival, Walk) plus Closing Well in its own body as instances of "reflect-on-action," but none of those ceremonies link back to it; the room was blind to a taxonomy it had already written down. A second, smaller pattern: SCHEMA — Reference (also under-linked) is cited by name in three of this room's operational cards (the README, Substrate Skill, Technical Diagram Standard) with none of those citations formalized in frontmatter. On the de-sprawl side, three "Graffiti Pass — Handoff" files and one already-self-declared-composted migration handoff are spent batons sitting in canon past their disposability window — their real content has already been folded into the entries they touched, and the palace's own Baton Ceremony says git is their archive. No directed flags were posted to this room.
